name: MetaboLights BH Extended ISA-JSON Profile
description: Child profile extending MetaboLights ISA-JSON profile for external BH-prefixed studies

$.studies[0].identifier.description: Study identifier MUST start with MTBLS, REQ, MHD, or BH followed by digits.

$.studies[0].filename.description: Study filename MUST match s_<ID>.txt or s_<ID>-study.txt.

$.studies[0].studyDesignDescriptors.description: At least 2 design descriptors MUST be defined.
